Xelvin is looking for an experienced Production Test Engineer with a strong Electrical Engineering background to join the engineering team of a leading technology company in Eindhoven. In this role, you will develop and implement production test solutions for advanced electronic systems, ensuring products meet the highest quality standards before entering serial production. This employer designs and manufactures highly advanced electronic systems for demanding industries such as semiconductors, industrial, automotive, medical and defense. As a Production Test Engineer, you will play a key role in bridging product development and manufacturing by designing, developing and maintaining production test solutions. Job description 
In this versatile role, you are the link between management and our curing/dairy team. You direct, motivate, and actively participate in the production process of our delicious specialty cheeses and dairy products. Here, you are responsible for curing, pressing, and brining high-quality specialty cheeses, as well as making our dairy products, such as yogurt and quark. You will be taught the cheesemaking process by our best cheesemakers. The duties of a curder involve ensuring the curd is prepared for pressing into cheese (this is done by hand). You ensure the cheeses are placed in the cheese vats and that they are turned. Additionally, you assist with cleaning equipment and machinery and are responsible for a hygienic work environment.
